description: link.v2's linter (v2.md §2.1, §2.4, §2.10, §2.11, §2.16), a face's `frames` and `horizon_s` among it. Each case is a face policy, `policy`, and `expect`, every finding of it, sorted by face (none first), `at`, then `code`, as link.v1's lints.json writes them. A policy with no `profile` is link.v1's, read finding for finding as link.v1 §2.1 says. A case may give a deployment and its windows as link.v1's lints.json does (`implements`, `contracts` or `interfaces`, `windows`): the plan is derived, and `window_under_outage` reads §2.11's floor.
